reviews.text: Staff kindly took my dog in with a last minute appointment for a checkup and prescription refill. Thank you!

Everyone who attended me was incredibly kind, informative, and patient. Dr. Hernandez and Dr. Lee attended my beloved Chanel (cat) and they were both gentle with her and Dr. Hernandez, specially checked in on me to make sure I was okay even if I wasn’t a patient myself. Special shoutout to Kiara who was kind and sweet as well. My whole experience was amazing!
Hi there - We appreciate you sharing your experience with Banfield Pet Hospital. 🧡 We’re grateful to be a part of your pet’s care team. …

This was one of the most frustrating experiences I've had at a veterinary clinic. The staff were dismissive, unhelpful, and did not clearly explain the costs of my puppy's care.

I was told the vaccine itself would cost around $30, but no one explained that returning for the next scheduled booster would also require another $93 exam fee. I only found this out after asking more questions. If that had been explained upfront, I would have made completely different decisions about my puppy's care.

What bothered me most was the attitude. Instead of acknowledging why this was frustrating, I felt like my concerns were brushed off. I wasn't asking for anything free—I just wanted transparent pricing so I could make an informed decision.

I also asked about the wellness plan, but the full financial commitment wasn't clearly explained during the conversation. It felt like I had to keep asking questions before important information was disclosed.

If your pet needs routine vaccines, I recommend getting a complete price breakdown before agreeing to anything. I left feeling like the communication was poor, the customer service was dismissive, and the experience was far more stressful than it needed to be.
Great experience with Banfield staff and vet

This Banfield is the best… We loved our vet at Beverly Robinson, but we needed something closer to home. This Petsmart was the first place we ever went with our adopted dog hopper - we adopted him from the SPCA la when he was 10 and he lived 7 years. His grooms, his checkups, his weigh ins. He was celebrated and loved the rest of his life here. When we knew it was time to say goodbye, they helped us. They supported us through his medical care and helped us make him a as comfortable as possible in the last 3 months of his rapid decline. They let us bring in our own blankets and we had our other dog with us. We made a small space so intimate. We laid with him, sang to him, made our own little clay paw prints with him. My husband held his face and looked into his eyes as he took his last breath and I rubbed his ribs, feeling his whole body melt into a state of immediate peace. They were compassionate, respectful, and let us grieve as much as we needed. It was difficult to walk out of the room without him. They didn’t judge us as our hearts literally broke in front of them. How do you write a five star review about one of the worst moments of your life? I guess this is what it looks like. We miss you, Hopper.  We think of you every day. Thank you, Banfield for your continued care for our animals.
Daniel - We're so glad you had a great experience!  We’ll make sure to pass this on to our Los Angeles location. Thanks for partnering with us for your pet’s needs. 🐾 …

This place is legit robbery!!!!!!! They charged me $1250 ($100 short of my rent btw) for my dog who experienced temporary paralysis- taking full advantage of the fact I was in scared mommy mode! They told me that she needed an xray for any answers, before the xray blood work is mandatory, and before blood work it’s “policy” that she received x vaccine. I was pressured into making the decision to pay for all of this out of fear for my dogs life! They threw around vague terms saying “some dogs get surgery and never recover” and that she might need a neurologist or an MRI. (More $$$!!!!!!)  They prescribed her inflammation meds and that’s it. The following day my dog got WORSE and when I called they told me bring her to the ER- which was the only good thing they did for me! I ended up at an AMAZING vet who told me that the xray was absolutely unnecessary- and would not even show results for what they were looking for / could assume it was based on how common this experience is in little dogs. He tried to ease the blow by saying ‘all vets would recommend, but it’s definitely not necessary, especially if you’re tight on money’- when this vet told me it was a NECESSITY! On top of that, I found out my dog was in pain the following day because they only gave me meds for inflammation- not even the nerve pain which is what caused her temporary paralysis!!!!!! This place is a cash grab, and on top of that most of the staff are cold and literally never answer the phone. When I was rushing to them the first time I tried to call them maybe 6x, and each time was put on hold immediately without someone even saying hello!  I will literally never go here again. Unclear, overpriced, lack of compassion, don’t give you enough in depth information, and clearly only care about money! Do vets work on commission??? This place will certainly make you feel like it!

Very rude and unprofessional. Made an appt for my dogs vaccines early due to boarding REQUIREMENTS. Put this in the appt notes, to which they called to confirm. Show up after driving and waiting at the front desk for 15 min to be helped for them to tell me they won’t vaccinate my dog since it’s too early.. then told me to come back in a few weeks. When I asked to talk to the vet they said “they’re busy” without even asking them in the back if they could talk to me….

Easily my worst experience with a vet. Absolutely don't go here. My dog was put on anxiety medication just to find that she is on far too high of a dose for her weight (this can literally cause serotonin syndrome!!!!) She was in better condition before being here now seeing my baby in even further pain is frustrating. Clearly, all these people care about is money and making your pet sicker so you come back. The laughable $90 off for being a first time customer and still the total coming to $345. The most expensive i have ever dealt with going to the vet putting her on anxiety medication and a general check up. Absolutely avoid this place at all cost.

This “hospital” is one of the most disappointing veterinary experiences I’ve ever had. I arrived with my sick dog for an 8:30 AM appointment and didn’t leave until about 6 PM. My phone died about 30 mins after the vet called (12:30pm) so I returned to the store (Petsmart) to wait for my dog. They couldn't reach me (my phone died) so instead of poking their head out to see if I'm in the waiting area, they just left it. Mind you, I was VERY present. THEY SAW ME waiting there, walking back & forth, at one point I was looking for my missing earbud for an hour. Despite the long wait, the staff’s energy was cold, rushed, and focused more on payment than care. I literally watched the doctors leave, thats how long I was there waiting on someone to say, "hey, your pet's ready to go"

This is not a hospital — it’s a clinic with a drop‑off system, meaning they take your pet to the back and you have no idea what’s happening. I will never agree to this again. There was no transparency, no updates, and no sense of urgency or compassion.

A nurse called and went over the options and pricing again before the doctor examined my dog. We agreed on a CBC and Urinalysis, and meds.

About an hour or so later, when the veterinarian called me (12:30pm), she told me my dog might be in “grave condition” and that she needed to see an internist. She said that my dog may have something that could be contagious to me as well and so I should see my doctor, too. But when I received the written report, it said almost nothing — just “eye and oral issue.” No explanation, no details, nothing that matched what we discussed, not even my dog's temperature. My dog's severe jaundice wasnt listed, nothing. There was no referral, NOTHING.  It felt like I was handed a receipt, not medical documentation. The phone convo was rushed, she didnt care about my dog's history beyond what was typed into the computer upon check-in, even the way the convo ended and she hung up, the whole thing was so cold and transactional. Again, not rude, but as a bartender and server for 20 years, I KNOW cold and transactional. Remember,  money is discussed AT LENGTH, but when it comes to care, its abrupt and rushed.

I also noticed a clear difference in how other customers (regulars with healthy dogs) were treated. They received attention and warmth. I did not. I wasn’t rude, and I wasn’t treated rudely — but I was treated like someone whose pet didn’t matter because I couldn’t afford every test they pushed. When I recieved the meds, I was informed 1 was missing that I am to pick up from a pharmacy because it was closed by then. I still have no idea which medication it is, which pharmacy to pick it up from, smh. I was totally over them by then. I just wanted out of there. When I got home is when I realized the paperwork I recieved were not test results at all, but a receipt, so they didnt even perform any tests. The costs were for meds and a prescription for food (i had a coupon for free 1st visit).

I’m grateful they sold me the medications and food my dog needed to be comfortable, but the overall service was unacceptable. I would not return here for anything beyond basic vaccines or a check-up if I were you unless you're willing to spend big on packages and services. I really thought this was a hospital as their name suggests, I would have never brought my sick dog to a glorified pet spa.
Dr Kenneth Lee had been such an angel! He has treated my baby with so much love and kindness. He has been super helpful and supportive throughout the process of my dogs recovery.

Dropped off my senior dog with heart disease at 11am. It’s 5pm and still nothing. I specifically let them know my dog has heart problems and had emergencies recently so it makes me anxious to have him there for a long period of time. Their promised pickup time was 1-3pm. Come on! Seems like they overbook pets and let them wait in cages. Extremely frustrating and disappointing.

Arrived for 3:00 pm scheduled appointment ( arrived 10 minutes early) with my cat. Left at 4:30 pm. Never had to wait for so long for a doctor in other Banfield hospitals. Additionally, my cat is a 10 year male old ragdoll. He weights 18 lbs.  Dr. Maldonado claimed he is obese. Iam sorry but it’s BS and ANY cats encyclopedia/ or simply google tell you that for 10 yo Male ragdoll average weight is 15-20lbs. Their bodies are very long. Ragdolls are one of the largest cat’s breeds and it a well-known fact. So NO, he is not obese, no need to compare him with some common shorthair breed. I don’t understand why they don’t teach doctors anything about how different breeds of the same animal can have different physical futures, and so the difference between males and females animals.
Also have to say that dr. Maldonado wasn’t friendly  at all and honestly don’t understand why they made me wait for her for so long when as a result she didn’t really have any new info on my cat. Also what the point of scheduling appointments if they make you wait for a doctor for so long.

Today I called Banfield Pet Hospital because my kitten had a scheduled surgery. The person who answered was incredibly unprofessional, lacking ethics and basic manners. I said "Good morning" three times, and she didn't respond each time. She had absolutely no idea my kitten had an appointment today and offered no assistance. She also claimed they had contacted me twice, saying, "Sindy called and reported that she called and they didn't answer," which is a lie. I have proof in the call log.
Viviana, as she claimed her name was, couldn't answer my questions, such as how long my kitten would have to be there on the day of surgery. She also didn't provide any information that would make me feel safe, as it concerns my life companion, and he is very important to me.
I regret having a contract with them. If they truly have call quality control, they can check the call log from today at 7:30 am to verify this. Even if the staff who don't work at reception are excellent and very friendly, we won't know because the first impression at reception ruins everything.
Please, I need help from whoever reads this to find out if there's any way to cancel the one-year contract, because every time I call or visit this place on Pico Blvd., I'm treated this way by the reception staff. It's not the first time I've seen this behavior, but I thought there would be more staff and the second time would be better. BIG MISTAKE. If they treat you badly the first time, the second time will be even worse.

Its inhumane that they have my dog in a kenel

I have been a Banfield client for over 10 years, with many of my pets on their wellness plans. I used to trust this company, but what happened at the Midtown Crossing location has left me horrified.

I scheduled an appointment only for my dog’s Symparica treatment and a nail trim. At drop-off, I made it clear that nothing else was needed. I did not request vaccines, and the notes on the appointment reflected that.

When I came to pick up my dog, staff casually informed me that they had given her two vaccines without my consent. I was never called, never asked, and no one confirmed whether vaccinations were actually due. Only after the fact did they ask if I was “aware of the side effects.” That is completely backwards.

Even worse, they never offered my dog Benadryl or any preventive medication to help reduce the risk of a reaction. Any professional veterinarian knows that giving unnecessary or duplicate vaccines can be dangerous, yet they provided no safeguard. This shows a complete lack of professionalism and care.

The doctor, Dr. Diana Maria Hernandez, and the nurse, Viviana Hernandez, both failed to contact me before administering these injections. They disregarded my clear instructions, and in doing so, they put my pet’s life in danger.

This is not just poor communication—it is unprofessional and negligent. In my opinion, they do not deserve to hold a veterinary license if they cannot respect consent, follow proper protocols, or prioritize animal safety.

I will be filing a legal complaint with Banfield corporate and the state veterinary board, and I fully expect this matter to result in legal action. I want every pet owner to be aware of what happened so no one else has to experience this kind of mistreatment.

Pets are family. They deserve safe, respectful, and professional care—not what my dog received at this Banfield location.

I cannot thank the team at Banfield enough for the incredible care they gave my 2-year-old Goldendoodle yesterday — especially on such short notice. I noticed she wasn’t herself and was showing some concerning symptoms. I called multiple vets in the area, but no one had availability or they were going to cost me an arm and a leg. When I called this Banfield location, I was greeted by a friendly, understanding voice who quickly pulled up my information from when we were patients at another Banfield during my dog’s first year.

After explaining my concerns and how desperate I was to get her seen, they didn’t hesitate to squeeze her in. I left work immediately to pick her up from home and bring her in. The receptionist was warm, patient, and walked me through the costs of the visit while also explaining their membership program, which instantly made me feel more at ease.

Since it was a drop-off appointment, I was told the doctor would call me with an update — and sure enough, about an hour and a half later, Dr. Diana called. She was absolutely wonderful: friendly, detailed, and thorough in explaining her findings. She took her time to answer all my questions, offered thoughtful recommendations for future visits, and even gave me an estimated pick-up time.

When I arrived later, the checkout process was smooth and easy, and I even got to choose which date each month my membership payment would be drafted — a small detail, but so appreciated! When the nurse (Catherine, I think?) brought out my pup, she was kind, professional, and explained the medications and at-home care clearly. My dog looked and felt so much better already, which brought me such relief.

From start to finish, every single team member went above and beyond. Their compassion, professionalism, and efficiency truly stood out. I’m beyond grateful for this team and will absolutely continue to return. Thank you all so much for taking such great care of my girl!
